facts.value: Urban Design and Climate Resilience - MSc

The Master of Science in Urban Design and Climate Resilience is a two-year full-time Level 9 professional degree programme. It is an intensive and dynamic programme and prepares you for the range of professional activities in Urban Design, Sustainability and Climate Resilience.
facts.programme_association: Urban Design and Climate Resilience - MSc

facts.value: The Design Studio is at the core of the teaching methodology.
facts.programme_association: Urban Design and Climate Resilience - MSc

facts.value: The programme is situated in The School of Architecture and Product Design and offers an interdisciplinary studio environment, guided by experts from fields such as urbanism, architecture, landscape architecture, ecology, history, science, and philosophy.
facts.programme_association: Urban Design and Climate Resilience - MSc

facts.value: The learning environment as a studio-based programme is experiential, challenge driven, student centred and collaborative.
facts.programme_association: Urban Design and Climate Resilience - MSc

facts.value: The programme is cutting edge in its content and therefore research-led, using current thinking and engaging students to develop contemporary research in the field of urban design and climate resilience.
facts.programme_association: Urban Design and Climate Resilience - MSc

facts.value: Students will develop the skills to analyse and address complex urban planning challenges.
facts.programme_association: Urban Design and Climate Resilience - MSc

facts.value: For the past 15 years, the School of Architecture and Product Design has led the Intelligence Unit (IU), a research initiative focused on contemporary urban and regional issues, particularly in Limerick.
facts.programme_association: Urban Design and Climate Resilience - MSc

facts.value: This new programme will become part of a Global IU, expanding its scope to explore urban challenges across diverse geographic, environmental, and political contexts.
facts.programme_association: Urban Design and Climate Resilience - MSc

facts.value: Wherever possible, we will collaborate with local stakeholders on real-world projects, ensuring that our work remains relevant and impactful.
facts.programme_association: Urban Design and Climate Resilience - MSc

facts.value: The School of Architecture and Product Design in Limerick has spent the past three years collaborating with the School of Architecture in Kharkiv, Ukraine, on the country’s rebuilding programme.
facts.programme_association: Urban Design and Climate Resilience - MSc

facts.value: This partnership has engaged NGOs, local public sector architects, mayoral departments, and international academics and practitioners.
facts.programme_association: Urban Design and Climate Resilience - MSc

facts.value: The collaboration has led to the launch of two new urban design programmes, one in Ireland and one in Ukraine running in parallel.

facts.value: In their first semester, and building on three years of joint work on Ukrainian cities, students from the School of Architecture in Limerick will contribute to Ukraine’s post-war rebuilding efforts alongside their counterparts in Kharkiv as part of the ‘Global IU.
